name: organization
label: Organization / Corporate Source Plan
purpose: Route analysts toward public corporate, registry, procurement and relationship sources.

steps.goal: Locate authoritative or well-sourced organization records.
steps.evidence_requirement: Distinguish official registry facts from third-party aggregation.
steps.stop_condition: Stop when authoritative identifiers and jurisdiction are established.

steps.goal: Map public relationships as candidate assertions.
steps.evidence_requirement: Every relationship must cite a source and remain an assertion until corroborated.
steps.stop_condition: Stop before inferring control or ownership beyond the evidence.

steps.evidence_requirement: Capture URL, timestamp and document/page context.
steps.stop_condition: Stop when sufficient evidence supports the assessment.
